description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing 'operations' within a Vue.js frontend application. It includes state, getters, and actions related to CRUD operations on 'operations'.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Adds a new operation to the store with a unique id and timestamp.

methods.name: updateOperation
methods.description: Updates an existing operation identified by id with provided update data.

methods.name: deleteOperation
methods.description: Removes an operation from the store by id.
